scope: Independent binding of the original rank/restriction subclaims in TeX prose:200; the full source paragraph also contains perturbation and cycle-bound limits, owned by the root agent.

assertions.exact_claim:
If $|P|=3$, the nonzero skew matrix $A_{PP}$ has rank two. Since $A\mu=0$, the $4	imes4$ skew matrix $A$ also has rank two. Its two-dimensional kernel cannot consist only of vectors vanishing at the unique label $k\in Z$, since restriction would inject it into $\ker A_{PP}$. Choose $
u\in\ker A$ with $
u_k>0$. For small $s>0$, $\mu+s
u$ is positive and solves the same angular equations. Apply \eqref{eq:cycle-bound} to the $k$th coordinate vector, divide by $s
u_k$, and let $s\downarrow0$:

lean_bindings.lean_statement:
DominantFiveBody.coorbital_three_source_ranks_and_kernel_dimensions (mass theta : Satellite → ℝ) (k : Satellite)
  (hzero : mass k = 0) (hmass : ∀ (i : Satellite), i ≠ k → 0 < mass i)
  (harc : ∀ (i j : Satellite), i < j → 0 < theta j - theta i ∧ theta j - theta i < Real.pi)
  (hroot : ∀ (i : Satellite), coorbitalResidual mass theta i = 0) :
  (coorbitalSupportMatrix theta k).rank = 2 ∧
    (coorbitalMatrix theta).rank = 2 ∧
      Module.finrank ℝ ↥(coorbitalMatrix theta).mulVecLin.ker = 2 ∧
        Module.finrank ℝ ↥(coorbitalSupportMatrix theta k).mulVecLin.ker = 1
lean_bindings.subclaim: Actual nonzero support A_PP has rank 2, full signed A has rank 2, full kernel finrank is 2, and the support kernel finrank is 1.

lean_bindings.lean_statement:
DominantFiveBody.coorbital_three_source_kernel_not_all_zero_at_missing_source (mass theta : Satellite → ℝ)
  (k : Satellite) (hzero : mass k = 0) (hmass : ∀ (i : Satellite), i ≠ k → 0 < mass i)
  (harc : ∀ (i j : Satellite), i < j → 0 < theta j - theta i ∧ theta j - theta i < Real.pi)
  (hroot : ∀ (i : Satellite), coorbitalResidual mass theta i = 0) : ∃ v ∈ (coorbitalMatrix theta).mulVecLin.ker, v k ≠ 0
lean_bindings.subclaim: The explicit linear restriction map would inject the full kernel into the support kernel if every vector vanished at the missing source, contradicting 2<=1.

lean_bindings.lean_statement:
DominantFiveBody.coorbital_three_source_kernel_vector_by_rank (mass theta : Satellite → ℝ) (k : Satellite)
  (hzero : mass k = 0) (hmass : ∀ (i : Satellite), i ≠ k → 0 < mass i)
  (harc : ∀ (i j : Satellite), i < j → 0 < theta j - theta i ∧ theta j - theta i < Real.pi)
  (hroot : ∀ (i : Satellite), coorbitalResidual mass theta i = 0) :
  ∃ nu, nu k = 1 ∧ ∀ (i : Satellite), coorbitalResidual nu theta i = 0
lean_bindings.subclaim: The original rank-and-restriction route supplies an actual signed matrix kernel vector with missing-source coordinate 1, hence positive.

remaining_dependencies: The small-s positive perturbation and the cycle-bound divide-and-limit estimates are distinct subclaims; this rank-only patch does not certify them. The root agent owns their exact binding.
